about: Every screen name scripts/store-screenshots.sh photos captures for Tenshu Photos (`captured`, from the UI test in `uiTests`), on iPhone 6.9" and iPad 13", light. The library is the landing set's stock photos re-dated six to a day (store/fixtures/photos/), uploaded through Drive's own seed launch on the same realm; the albums and the favourite are made in Photos by taps (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §3d). Adding a capture means adding it here. `landing` is the landing page's own set (§9). Docs: docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §5.

01-library.shows: The library: the default mosaic, grouped by day

02-collections.shows: Collections: Favourites and Duplicates, three albums with their covers, the years and the Trash

03-album.shows: The Outdoors album (31 photos), made through New album and filled from a library selection

04-viewer.shows: One photo full screen in the viewer, made a favourite with its heart

05-months.shows: The library grouped by month, through its grouping button
